note: Missouri Department of Conservation preserve of rolling hills, fields and woods in north-west Cape Girardeau County, with an archery range, fishing ponds and dog field trials. MDC's map marks one primitive camping area beside parking lot #3, a gravel lot at the archery range on the area's gravel road; no facilities, and the brochure bans open fires and fireworks. Reached by County Road 472 west of Route B. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: one map-designated primitive camping area at parking lot #3 by the archery range (GIS 374). Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Pin moves ~90 m out of woods onto lot #3. Phone matches; not waterfront kept.
flags: INCLUSION OK (lot-side designated point): area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; brochure 'Camping permitted only in designated areas'; the area map's legend has 'Primitive Camping Area' and places its single symbol just south of 'Parking Lot #3' at the archery range; GIS 27 point 374 'Maintz Wildlife Preserve Primitive Camping Area'. Rule 140 standard; no special-use-only rule, no Rule 101. Camping is beside a gravel lot, kept under the designated-point rule (as Lick Creek); the spot is next to the archery range.

PIN (move ~90 m): stored 37.48680,-89.79744 = GIS 374, under forest canopy ~40 m east of the gravel road. Move onto lot #3 (GIS 26 lot 770): 37.4876,-89.7976, a gravel lot of roughly 25 x 30 m on the gravel area road - a 23-ft rig fits. No low-water crossing on the route from CR 472.
FIRES: brochure 'No fireworks or open fires.' - in the note.
HORSES: brochure 'No horseback riding.' CLUSTERS: a single camping symbol among nine lots.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept (small fishing ponds only; none at the lot).
